label: 24V 24W gigabit passive PoE injector
description: Single-port passive 24V PoE adapter that feeds 24 VDC at 1 A (24 W) over the spare pairs to an airMAX radio or other 24V-only device. It does no 802.3af/at detection or classification, so it will apply 24V to any device plugged in regardless of what that device expects.
